result.title: [KR][Task] Update Currency Display Format Based on Selected Language
result.description:
Background

The KR notification emails have already been updated to use the Korean currency format: 000 원

The remaining currency displays on the Magnolia storefront still need to be adjusted based on the selected site language.

Requirement

The KR site currency format should change dynamically according to the selected language:

  • EN: KRW 000
  • KO: 000 원

This rule should be applied consistently across all Magnolia storefront pages and components that display KRW amounts.


Scope

Please update the currency display format on the following areas:

  • Homepage
  • PLP
  • PDP
  • Sector Hub Page
  • Campaign Page
  • Chat
  • Checkout Page
  • Order List
  • Order Detail Page

Expected Behavior

  • English
    • When the selected language is EN:
    • KRW 100,000
  • Korean
    • When the selected language is KO:
    • 100,000 원

cc @EricBA.Huang @Manoj.Kumar
result.acceptance_criteria:
1. When KR site language is EN, all KRW amounts are displayed as KRW {amount}
  2. When KR site language is KO, all KRW amounts are displayed as {amount} 원
  3. The format is applied consistently across Homepage, PLP, PDP, Sector Hub, Campaign Page, Chat, Checkout, Order List, and Order Detail Page.
  4.  Switching language updates the currency format accordingly.
  5.  Currency value/calculation is not changed; only the display format is updated.
  6.  Other currencies and other sites are not affected.
  7.  Existing KR notification email format remains unchanged.
